parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Pour 200 cm of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the beaker of hot water,
as shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
When the thermometer reading stops rising, record in Table 2.1 the temperature θ of
the hot water at time t = 0 s. Immediately start the stopclock.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
After 30 s, measure the temperature θ shown on the thermometer. Record the time
t = 30 s and the temperature reading in the table.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Continue recording the time and temperature readings every 30 s until you have six sets
of readings.
